reason: If I really need a part that nobody in Baghdad has, I'll try them once, because I can pay with Zain Cash and the agents I know also take weeks. But two to three weeks is slow for me, so it will only be for the thing I can't find any other way, not a regular habit yet.
objection: Taobao is full of copies. If what comes is fake or not the quality in the picture, will they call that 'not as ordered' and refund me, or will they say it matches the link and I lose my money? And 2-3 weeks is too long when I need something now.
would_change_my_mind: A faster option, around one week even if it costs more, and someone I know who got a refund from them when the item was wrong.
